newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Kandir to tell Senate about CVRD.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Kandir to tell Senate about CVRD.

text.p: Brazilian Planning Minister Antonio Kandir will inform a Senate committee Thursday morning about the planned privatization of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), officials said.
An official of the Senate Infrastructure Committee said Kandir's previously unscheduled testimony was due to begin at 1000 local/1300 GMT.
The ministry declined to confirm that Kandir would testify.

Bid specifications for the sell-off of CVRD, due to begin in April, were expected to be made public Friday. They were not expected to include a minimum price for an initial block sale of 40-45 percent of voting shares nor to set a firm date.
Government sources said the minister would not attend a National Monetary Council (CMN) at 1000 local. The CMN is Brazil's highest monetary policy-making body.
